description: Loki single-binary log store: ingestion, rejected data, ingester, query performance, storage/retention and resources. Metrics come from Loki's /metrics endpoint, the kubelet and kube-state-metrics.

panels.description: Whether Prometheus can scrape Loki's /metrics endpoint.
panels.title: Status

panels.description: Share of Loki HTTP API requests (push and queries) answered with a 5xx in the selected range.
panels.title: 5xx Ratio

panels.description: Loki container restarts in the selected range.
panels.title: Restarts

panels.description: Restarts in the selected range of containers whose last termination reason was OOMKilled. kube-state-metrics only keeps the most recent reason, so a pod that OOMed and later crashed for another reason is not counted.

targets.expr: sum(increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{namespace="loki", container="loki"}[$__range]) * on (namespace, pod, container) group_left () max by (namespace, pod, container) (max_over_time(kube_pod_container_status_last_terminated_reason{namespace="loki", container="loki", reason="OOMKilled"}[$__range]))) or vector(0)

panels.title: OOM Kills

panels.description: Failed HTTP requests per route. 5xx on push means log lines were rejected (Alloy will retry); 5xx on query_range usually means a query timed out or ran out of memory.
panels.title: HTTP 5xx by Route

panels.description: Log lines Loki refused to store (rate_limited, line_too_long, stream_limit, too_far_behind, ...). These lines are lost.
panels.title: Discarded Samples by Reason

panels.description: Lines per second Loki itself logged at warn or error level.
panels.title: Error and Warning Log Messages

panels.description: Log lines accepted by the distributor per second.
panels.title: Lines Received

panels.description: Uncompressed log bytes accepted per second. The per-tenant ingestion limit is ingestion_rate_mb=10 (burst 20).
panels.title: Bytes Received

panels.description: Push requests per second by status code (204 = accepted), with p99 push latency on the right axis.
panels.title: Push Requests

panels.description: Active streams held by the ingester (each unique label set is one stream) and how fast new streams appear. Fast stream churn points at a high-cardinality label.
panels.title: In-Memory Streams

panels.description: Chunks waiting in memory to be flushed to disk, and the flush queue length. A growing flush queue means storage cannot keep up.
panels.title: In-Memory Chunks and Flush Queue

panels.description: Chunks flushed to storage per minute by reason (idle, full, max_age, synced), plus flush failures.
panels.title: Chunk Flushes

panels.description: Read API requests per second by route and status code (query, query_range, labels, series...). 499 means the client gave up.
panels.title: Query Requests

panels.description: End-to-end HTTP latency of instant and range queries.
panels.title: Query Latency

panels.description: Sub-queries waiting in the scheduler queue, queries in progress in the frontend, and sub-queries executing on querier workers. A queue that stays above zero means Loki cannot keep up with query load.
panels.title: Query Queue

panels.description: Used share of the loki-storage PVC (chunks, index, WAL, compactor working dir). Loki stops accepting writes when it fills.
panels.title: Volume Used

panels.description: loki-storage PVC usage reported by the kubelet. Retention is 744h (31 days), so growth should level off after a month.
panels.title: Volume Usage

panels.description: Compressed chunk bytes written to storage per second.
panels.title: Chunk Data Written

panels.description: Time since the compactor last compacted index tables and last applied retention. Both run every 10 minutes; hours means the compactor is stuck.
panels.title: Since Last Successful Run

panels.description: CPU cores used per pod (cAdvisor) against the container CPU limit.
panels.title: CPU

panels.description: Container working-set memory per pod (what the OOM killer compares) against the memory limit.
panels.title: Memory vs Limit

panels.description: Container restarts per pod within each interval (kube-state-metrics).
panels.title: Restarts

panels.description: Loki's own error-level log lines.
panels.title: Loki Errors

title: Loki
